crossRefs.note: Yahweh prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse…
God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their…
God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to…
For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.
He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number,
Why, when I came, was there no one? When I called, why was there no one to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it…
The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be…
For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell…
He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there…
The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

people.name: Jonah
people.line: Prophet swallowed by fish, preached to Nineveh

translations.web: Then Yahweh spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
translations.bsb: And the LORD commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry
translations.asv: And Jehovah spake unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
